dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent circular and elliptical rings on the mid-to-posterior lateral flank exhibiting high-contrast outer perimeters with sharp transitions from dark charcoal exteriors to light grey-beige interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, irregular light-colored pixel clusters distributed between larger annuli, concentrated primarily along the upper lateral transition zone towards the dorsal line.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A prominent scalene triangular relationship formed by the centroids of three large annuli on the upper mid-flank, with a secondary trapezoidal arrangement of smaller spots located anterior to the pectoral flipper base.

other_distinctive_markers: Five distinct, elongated light-colored keratinous claws on the right pectoral flipper, showing significant contrast against the dark digital webbing.
